courses.title: MS Word
courses.description: Practical MS Word training based on the Joining Hands curriculum.

lessons.title: Lesson 1 — Preparing Application Form
steps: Open Microsoft Word and create a blank document.
Set up the page and create the basic form layout.
Insert the picture/clip art and resize it to match the sample.
Create the Form No. area using a table.
Type “Application for Admission” and format it as shown.
Create the applicant-information lines and phone-number boxes.
Create the “Acknowledgement Receipt and Hall Ticket” section.
Add the counseling information, signatures and date.
Compare your document with the Project 1 sample before submitting.
lessons.practical: Recreate the complete Application for Admission form shown in Project 1.

lessons.title: Lesson 2 — Prepare an Admission Notification
learn: Arrange elements to match the sample
steps: Open a blank Word document.
Create the page border and basic layout.
Add the university heading and admission title.
Enter the eligibility and application information.
Add the highlighted last-date section.
Create the two information boxes at the bottom.
Add the date and page number.
Compare your result with the Project 2 sample.
lessons.practical: Recreate the Admission Notification shown in Project 2.

lessons.title: Lesson 3 — Prepare a Sale Advertisement
steps: Create the page background and main heading.
Insert WordArt for the main sale title.
Insert the required shapes and type the offer text.
Format colours, outlines and effects.
Arrange the offers and supporting text.
Add the bottom promotional information.
Compare your work with Project 3.
lessons.practical: Recreate the Sale Advertisement shown in Project 3.

lessons.title: Lesson 4 — Prepare a Cover Page of a Book
learn: Use text boxes and formatting effects
steps: Set the page and create the main title.
Insert and format the large arrow shapes.
Add the mathematics guidebook text.
Insert the picture and thought bubble.
Create the information box and highlighted text.
Create the publishing-house section.
Arrange and align all objects to match the sample.
lessons.practical: Recreate the Book Cover Page shown in Project 4.

lessons.title: Lesson 5 — Prepare a Sales Advertisement
learn: Use shapes, tables and text boxes
steps: Create the page border and heading.
Add the clothing image and title.
Create the large SALE WordArt.
Create the discount circle and other promotional shapes.
Create the fashion-and-style section.
Insert the store table.
Add the discount list and align all elements.
lessons.practical: Recreate the Sales Advertisement shown in Project 5.

lessons.title: Lesson 6 — Prepare a Marketing Planning Cycle
learn: Arrange multiple objects on one page
steps: Create the blue title/header area.
Create the cycle using shapes and arrows.
Add the Analysis, Objectives, Strategy, Resources, Implementation and Evaluation sections.
Format the bullet points and headings.
Create the Guidance Sheet for Marketing Planning section.
Align and arrange all objects to match Project 6.
lessons.practical: Recreate the Marketing Planning Cycle shown in Project 6.
